lead_raw_text:
The structure of Ce4N4O12 (reduced formula CeNO3) crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I4_1/amd (No. 143), with 20 atoms per unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies octahedral Ce centers coordinated by six O neighbors, while N centers adopt tetrahedral environments with four O neighbors. The CeO6 octahedra share corners and edges with one another, and edge-sharing is also observed between tetrahedral N polyhedra and octahedral Ce polyhedra. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 20 sites.
